in_hebrew.name: Gowon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gowon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the ancient name 'Gauwyn', meaning 'powerful' or 'warrior'. In Welsh mythology, Gowon was a legendary king known for his courage and strength. In Christianity, the name can symbolize one's spiritual power and commitment to overcoming challenges.
